items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: And he used to take me to these get-togethers

ctx.x: indeed well tell me about even before you were playing you heard music

Oh yes! Before I played, well I was a kid and my kid brother, my brother, at least my brother Jules, he played music around the house and my sister, my bop and all. They played, you know, this Paul stuff, the family thing. And incidentally, Paul Mares, a trumpet player at the New Orleans Rhythm King, his father, they lived just a couple of blocks from my house, see, and they used to have a little band, they used to practice, you know, and play, I don't know how to explain this thing, but my dad played alto with…
Nothing creative about it. Nothing, ah, nah, nah, now we get somewhere, see.
